title: Illustrations linked to records (images linked, never copied)

number.description: Number at the start of the Archive.org file name (the uploader's numbering, not Doré's plate number).

suffix.description: The uploader's optional mark after the number. The Apocrypha files use x; those files are not in this set, and a non-empty suffix is rejected.

title.description: Title from the file name, as uploaded. The text after the number, the optional suffix, and the space.

original_width.description: Pixel size of the Archive.org original (IIIF info.json, v2 then v3, or the JPEG header where both timed out).

display_height.description: Height of the 1200 px wide display image, for the img width/height attributes (no layout shift).

scripture_ref.description: OSIS reference, only where the title names one passage. Identified from the title; not printed on the plate. A chapter-level ref is used when the title gives the chapter and the scene is not pinned to verses.

ref.description: OSIS reference that places this person in the scene. Required when basis is in-scripture-passage.
